label: A thinking subject from experienced thought and phenomenal bearer coverage
meaning: Transcription (instantiation). With Occurs interpreted as thought occurrence throughout, take the occurring experienced episode, obtain its bearer under the local principle, and retain that same episode in the thinking-subject witness. The control has two occurring thoughts and restricts both experience and bearing to one. The all-thought bearer principle fails there. Emptying the bearer relation leaves the same phenomenal occurrence without a thinking subject.
